# Tags, correspondents and documents — user story

> Hand-written test input for stage B (docs/status/blackbox/001 D8). Written from the product's
> documentation, not its code.

## Tags

As an archivist, I label documents with tags.

- I can create a tag with a name; it is then listed among the tags.
- Two tags cannot have the same name.
- A tag without a name is refused.
- I can delete a tag; afterwards it can no longer be fetched.

## Correspondents

As an archivist, I record who sent a document.

- I can create a correspondent with a name and fetch it back.
- A correspondent without a name is refused.

## Documents

As an archivist, I upload documents and the archive processes them in the background.

- Uploading a PDF is accepted straight away and gives me a task to follow.
- Once the task has finished, the document can be found among the documents.

## Access

- Nobody can list tags, correspondents or documents without logging in.
